vocabulary.definition: a song that you can't stop hearing over and over in your head
vocabulary.example: That new pop song is such an earworm - I can't get it out of my head!

vocabulary.definition: an affectionate or bittersweet feeling for a happy time in the past
vocabulary.example: Listening to old jazz music gives me a nostalgic streak for my childhood.

vocabulary.definition: a person that influences what people think is popular or fashionable at the moment
vocabulary.example: As a famous fashion designer, she is considered a tastemaker in the industry.
